correctness.rationale: Reconstructed clique dichotomy: intervals of k successive edges versus exactly k exceptional triangles [a,a+k,a+2k]. Independently exhaustive clique enumeration for k=2,3,4 yields respectively 26,75,196 faces, precisely interval-core faces plus 2,3,4 exceptional triangles. The interval core is a good circular-arc nerve homotopy S1 and its radial map sends the embedded C_{3k} once around; each exceptional triangular boundary has degree +1, giving primitive relative differential (1,...,1):Z^k->Z. Relative long exact sequence gives free H2 kernel, H1=0 and wedge after first disk kills pi1. Rotation cyclically permutes triangle orientations, reflections reverse sign; the quotient target is sign, so integral representation follows, rather than only rational character. Finite tests not used for all k.
